items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A guy named Jazzbo Collins. You know him? You know of him.

ctx.x: It will come back to you later.

Anyway, we started, and it was obvious that things were going very well. Nothing was said about leaving. We were there for a year before anybody said anything. The owner, for him to smile or say . . . he never said anything, like things were going well. He might try to crack a smile, but he was a very grumpy guy, because he didn’t want anyone to know that business was good, in case they asked for a raise. We did eventually get a little money.
